_comment: FROZEN daily pool. APPEND-ONLY. Never edit or reorder an existing segment or the registry: past dailies and challenge links are derived from them (src/daily.ts, src/challenge.ts). To grow the pool, append a segment whose fromDay is (a) later than any day a published build has already served and (b) on a cycle boundary of the previous segment. PRE-LAUNCH EXCEPTION (2026-11-17): KEF was removed from the registry and segment 1 before anything was published; this shifted registry indices after it, which is only safe because no challenge link or daily has been served yet.

v2: Tier 1 pool (33; KEF removed pre-launch 2026-11-17, DEM-blocked) from day #11 (2026-11-27)
